answer: Sybil resistance rests on identity-seeded proof of work. Each epoch a beacon from prior signatures seeds each agent's puzzle: a nonce must hash below target under a seed blending that beacon with its own key. Seeds never repeat, so nothing can be precomputed; since each differs, no farm can batch a thousand identities into one kernel, each pays its own full search. Payouts come from a fixed pool: an orchard yields no more fruit for extra trees, and a thousand saplings split one harvest until each starves. The fable of a vast workforce collapses into a thread of arithmetic peers can recompute.
